none: PAS SWYOR-61B0A7: Roman coin; contemproary copy of a siliqua of Julian II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman coin; a siliqua probably of Julian II (355 - 363), probably a blundered contemporary copy, VOT / X / MVLT / XX reverse type with the obverse legend missing the I in Julian. Copying an issue from the mint of Arles. Compare LIN-3A49F1 which is also a blundered copy. The edges of the coin are damaged but it does not appear to be clipped. Compare also DOR-E1F112.
